name: Project Toon
summary:
Welcome to the delightful world of "Project Toon," a fan-made Gorilla Tag game that injects a burst of cartoonish fun into the high-energy gameplay. Embrace the whimsical cartoon graphics that bring a playful and lively vibe.
Project Toon stands out with its vibrant and exaggerated cartoon graphics. Dive into a visually charming world filled with bold colors and amusing character designs that set the stage for a lighthearted and entertaining experience.
